headline: Iran says it hit American vessels, oil tankers in Hormuz
detail: Escalating U.S.-Iran conflict drives oil prices up, creating risk-off sentiment. This typically hurts growth-oriented tech/chip names, especially on margin.
rec: Watch your overall portfolio risk. Geopolitical tensions often lead to broader market pullbacks, impacting your tech/chip holdings.

headline: U.S. reveals import ban on slew of Canadian goods
detail: Trade wars create economic uncertainty and can disrupt supply chains, potentially impacting global tech companies. This adds to the risk-off environment.
rec: Monitor for broader economic slowdowns or supply chain disruptions that could affect your tech/chip investments.

headline: Google to invest record $15 billion in AI infrastructure
detail: This is a strong positive signal for the AI and semiconductor sectors, indicating continued demand and investment. It could provide a tailwind for your chip holdings.
rec: Consider NVDA for a new buy: scanner entry 225.25-225.02, stop 224.5. This news supports the AI/chip sector.
